newsitem.title: FRANCE: France EDF cuts electricity rates from April 20.
newsitem.headline: France EDF cuts electricity rates from April 20.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Friday that planned cuts in the rates charged by state-owned electric utility EDF would take effect on Sunday and save consumers in total 10 billion francs a year.
"The reductions, which will take effect on Sunday, will translate into annual savings of about 10 billion francs for intermediate- and end-users," Arthuis said.

At the franc's current value, the rate cuts will amount to a 3.2 percent reduction for individuals, 9.2 percent for craftspeople and small businesses and between 2.7 percent and 5.7 percent for big firms and other users.
The rate cuts were agreed as part of a new contract between EDF and the state, which allowed for a cut in prices of 14 percent by the year 2000.
